Class SshSessionController.ConnectRequest

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshSessionController.ConnectRequest
Enclosing class:
SshSessionController
public static class SshSessionController.ConnectRequest extends Object
The ConnectRequest is a snapshot of the connection fields taken when Connect or Reconnect is pressed. The worker reads this snapshot. The worker does not read the window fields again.

clayl (2026-08-24)

  • Constructor Details

    • ConnectRequest

      public ConnectRequest(String host, int port, String username, String password, SshSessionMode mode, int columns, int rows)
      The constructor stores a connection snapshot that does not disconnect for idle time. The idle timeout is 0.
      Parameters:
      host - The host is the remote server address.
      port - The port is the remote TCP port.
      username - The username is the SSH account name.
      password - The password is the SSH password for that account.
      mode - The mode is the SshSessionMode that chooses VT100 or standard PTY.
      columns - The columns value is the initial PTY width in characters.
      rows - The rows value is the initial PTY height in characters.

    • ConnectRequest

      public ConnectRequest(String host, int port, String username, String password, SshSessionMode mode, int columns, int rows, long idleTimeoutMs)
      The constructor stores every field of one connection snapshot. A later read returns these same values.
      Parameters:
      host - The host is the remote server address.
      port - The port is the remote TCP port.
      username - The username is the SSH account name.
      password - The password is the SSH password for that account.
      mode - The mode is the SshSessionMode that chooses VT100 or standard PTY.
      columns - The columns value is the initial PTY width in characters.
      rows - The rows value is the initial PTY height in characters.
      idleTimeoutMs - The idle timeout is the idle limit in milliseconds, and 0 means the client does not disconnect for idle time.
